dc:title: political_parties
dc:description: This repository is shipped with a list of political parties that have been represented in Folketinget during the time period covered by this data set. political_parties is provided is provided in csv and rds formats in /data/processed. Refer to the documentation for more details.

columns.name: party
columns.dc:title: Abbreviation
columns.dc:description: Code for the political party, using the common abbreviation for Greenlandic Parties and the party letter code (Bogstavsbetegnelse) for Faroese parties

columns.name: full_name
columns.dc:title: Name
columns.dc:description: Name of the political party. Names are spelled according to standardised orthography and, in terms of morphology, in nominative (Faroese) resp. absolutive (Greenlandic) case

columns.name: wikidata_id
columns.dc:title: Wikidata ID
columns.dc:description: Wikidata Identifier for the entity representing each party

columns.name: party_family
columns.dc:title: Party Family
columns.dc:description: Title of the political party family the party is part of, taken from the ParlGov database (Döring, Huber, and Manow 2022)

columns.name: colour
columns.dc:title: Colour
columns.dc:description: HEX Code of the main colour associated with the policial party, taken from Wikipedia

columns.name: origin
columns.dc:title: Origin
columns.dc:description: Geographical origin of the party, using ISO 3166-2 codes

columns.name: left_right
columns.dc:title: Left-Right Position
columns.dc:description: left_right indicates where a party’s positions are located on a scale from 0 (left) to 10 (right), taken from the ParlGov database (Döring, Huber, and Manow 2022)

columns.name: state_market
columns.dc:title: State-Market Position
columns.dc:description: state_market indicates where a party’s positions on regulating the economy are located on a scale from 0 (preferring state regulations) to 10 (preferring unregulated markets), taken from the ParlGov database (Döring, Huber, and Manow 2022)

columns.name: liberty_authority
columns.dc:title: Liberty-Authority Position
columns.dc:description: liberty_authority indicates indicates a party’s position on a scale from 0 (libertarian) to 10 (authoritarian), taken from the ParlGov database (Döring, Huber, and Manow 2022)

columns.name: anti_pro_eu
columns.dc:title: Anti-Pro EU Position
columns.dc:description: anti_pro_eu indicates a party’s position towards EU integration on a scale from 0 (in favor of EU integration) to 10 (against EU integration), taken from the ParlGov database (Döring, Huber, and Manow 2022)
